chars.name: 현
chars.color: faded worn light gray-white with small patches
chars.look: A 20-year-old Korean young man of the Joseon dynasty, a poor fallen-noble scholar: slim, young clean-shaven face with no beard and no mustache, calm intelligent eyes, black hair in a topknot under a black gat hat, a worn faded light gray-white dopo robe with small patches on the sleeves, thin dark cord belt, white socks and straw sandals
chars.look_ko: 20살 몰락 양반 선비 현, 수염 없음, 갓, 해지고 기운 옅은 회백색 도포

chars.name: 어머니
chars.look: A 45-year-old Korean woman of the Joseon dynasty, his poor mother: thin, gentle tired face, black hair in a low bun with a plain wooden hairpin, a faded beige jeogori jacket and a dark navy chima skirt, no hat
chars.look_ko: 45살 어머니, 쪽머리, 빛바랜 베이지 저고리·남색 치마

chars.name: 판서
chars.look: A 56-year-old Korean man of the Joseon dynasty, an arrogant corrupt high minister (NOT a king): heavy-set with a round belly, a gray mustache and short gray beard, narrow greedy eyes, a dark crimson official robe with ONE square embroidered crane badge on the chest and ONE square crane badge on the back, NO dragons, NO round golden badges, nothing on the shoulders, black samo official hat with two thin flat wings sticking out to the left and right, black boots, the same hat and robe in all three views
chars.look_ko: 56살 탐욕스러운 판서, 뚱뚱함, 회색 수염, 붉은 관복·흉배·사모

chars.name: 임금
chars.look: A 40-year-old Korean king of the Joseon dynasty: tall, calm dignified face, neat short black beard, a bright red royal robe with golden round dragon badges on the chest and shoulders, the king's black ikseongwan cap, jade belt, black boots
chars.look_ko: 40살 임금, 단정한 검은 수염, 붉은 곤룡포·금색 용 보·익선관

chars.name: 도현
chars.look: A 54-year-old Korean man in the year 2045, an infectious disease research scientist: medium build, short neat gray-black hair, thin rimless glasses, kind tired eyes, a white lab coat over a light blue shirt and dark trousers, black shoes
chars.look_ko: 2045년 54살 감염병 연구자 도현, 흰 가운, 무테안경

chars.name: 수령
chars.look: A 35-year-old Korean county magistrate of the Joseon dynasty: thin body, a thin black mustache, sly narrow eyes, a dark navy blue official robe with ONE square embroidered badge on the chest and ONE on the back, black belt, black samo official hat with two thin flat wings sticking out to the left and right, black boots, the same hat and robe in all three views
chars.look_ko: 35살 박 수령, 마른 몸·콧수염, 남색 관복·사모

chars.name: 관찰사
chars.look: A 60-year-old Korean provincial governor of the Joseon dynasty: dignified, a long white beard and white eyebrows, stern wise eyes, a dark green official robe with ONE plain square embroidered crane badge on the chest, round collar, black belt, black brimless two-tiered samo official cap (exactly like the reference sheet) with two small thin flat oval wings sticking out to the left and right at the back, black boots, the same hat and robe in all three views
